newsitem.title: FRANCE: Versace family want respect for their loss.
newsitem.headline: Versace family want respect for their loss.

text.p: The Versace family on Tuesday called for silent respect for their pain after world-renowned fashion designer Gianni Versace was shot dead outside his mansion in Miami Beach.
"In advance, we thank all those who in silence, will respect our pain," a written statement from family members Santo and Donatella Versace said.
Jacques Mouclier, president of the Chambre Syndicale de la Couture, French fashion's governing body, paid tribute to Versace's wide-ranging interests.
"He is a man who went beyond fashion. He is one of those designers who also try to express themselves in other fields," Mouclier told reporters.
French television recalled Versace was a theatre lover and had designed costumes for several plays.
Versace, 50, was shot twice at close range in the back of the head, apparently by a man aged about 25 who approached him at the gates of the mansion shortly before 9 a.m. EDT (1300 GMT).
